manifest.name: Poly
manifest.description: ETH and UZH in Valley: the eLink shuttle between ETH Zentrum and Hönggerberg, today's menu plan of ETH Zentrum, ETH Hönggerberg and the UZH outlets, a campus map of ETH's buildings with their floors and rooms, in 2D and in the Stadt Zürich 3D model, ETH News with the Zukunftsblog, Globe and the media releases, read in Valley, and your subjects' Polybox links.
